Independent exact-head review of `33384bf03752bc16d5317658822741067b3cd729` against base `184107d5705248427d322922077d18f51e133c15` and the approved ConnectionContext design: no blocking findings identified. The diff is additive and bounded to the existing Governed Session/Operational Memory authority; `ConnectionContext` is strict/versioned/optional+nullable, OAuth-only, preserves legacy records without backfill, remains stable across attach/resume lifecycle, and shared credentials persist `null`. Existing auth guarantees the `oauth:<subject>` principal invariant before session operations. Existing OperationalAudit remains allowlisted and does not journal the new principal/client values. No token, Authorization header, resume secret/hash, or raw transport identifier is copied into the context. Exact-head MCP CI run 33475363940 / #706 is successful, including typecheck, build, docs, governance tests, secret scan, 271/271 read-only safety, and whitespace checks. Review threads observed: none. This review does not declare the task DONE; Ready/merge/deploy/runtime attestation remain required.

Independent continuation review on the current carrier PR #68, exact head `33384bf03752bc16d5317658822741067b3cd729`, exact base `184107d5705248427d322922077d18f51e133c15`: no blocking findings. The branch/head is unchanged from reviewed Draft #67. The implementation remains additive within the existing Governed Session / Operational Memory authority; OAuth principal formation is enforced upstream, shared credentials yield `connectionContext=null`, historical records remain compatible without backfill, lifecycle operations preserve the same context, and the operational audit allowlist does not persist the new principal/client values. No parallel authority or direct S1 write is introduced. Merge remains gated on the current PR's `validate` check, zero unresolved threads, unchanged head, active `protect-main` ruleset, exact-head merge guard, then governed deployment and runtime reconciliation.
